title: Fourier expansion of the restriction
statement: Fix coordinates $2$ and $3$ to $1$ and $−1$, respectively. For every choice of signs $y_0,y_1\in\{−1,1\}$ at coordinates $0$ and $1$, the sign-valued restriction of the four-coordinate Boolean function is $−\frac12+\frac12y_0+\frac12y_1+\frac12y_0y_1$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ assigns signs to the two free coordinates $0$ and $1$
